item.title: France ditches Zoom and Teams as Europe seeks to cut digital ties to the U.S.
item.description: In France, civil servants will ditch Zoom and Teams for a homegrown video conference system. Soldiers in Austria are using open source office software to write reports after the military dropped Microsoft Office. Bureaucrats in a German state have also turned to free software for their administrative work. item.description: Lior Pozin had an epiphany about AI infrastructure in early 2025. item.title: Firefox just made an unexpected move that Chrome would never copy
item.description: Firefox has a reputation as the browser of choice for power users who prefer to customize everything—and it just gave users one very important new option. While most other tech companies shove AI “enhancements” down their users’ throats, Mozilla is introducing a way to disable Firefox’s artificial intelligence features outright—a boon for anyone searching for a safe haven from the AI software onslaught. item.title: Is your state making school zones more dangerous?
item.description: Ignaz Semmelweis was a Hungarian physician working in a maternity ward in the 1840s.
